description: This file defines common types, enums, constants, and structures used across the Rialto media component, including media source types, network and playback states, media configurations, and encryption details.

classes.name: firebolt::rialto::AudioConfig
classes.description: Structure representing audio configuration including number of channels, sample rate, and codec-specific configuration.

classes.name: firebolt::rialto::VideoRequirements
classes.description: Structure specifying maximum width and height for video decoding requirements.

classes.name: firebolt::rialto::MediaPlayerShmInfo
classes.description: Structure containing shared memory information for media data and metadata.

classes.name: firebolt::rialto::QosInfo
classes.description: Structure for quality of service metrics, including processed and dropped frames or samples.

classes.name: firebolt::rialto::WebAudioShmInfo
classes.description: Structure with shared memory offsets and lengths for web audio playback buffers.

classes.name: firebolt::rialto::WebAudioPcmConfig
classes.description: Structure describing PCM configuration for web audio, including rate, channels, sample size, and endianness.

classes.name: firebolt::rialto::WebAudioConfig
classes.description: Union for web audio configuration data, currently supporting PCM configuration.
